Maya (Design): Drafting a new compact roles view: show three "priority" chips next to role name, collapse rest under an expandable grid. Quick mock: https://staging.redwood.design/compact-roles :sparkles:
Jon (PM): Main goals: fast scan for critical perms (billing, remove members, manage apps) and clear defaults in invite flow. Avoid 'Admin' label.
Ivy (Frontend): Accessibility: chips must be buttons with aria-pressed and clear aria-labels. No hover-only reveals. Use virtualization for large orgs.
Carlos (Research): In quick usability sessions, people missed tiny icons. Recommend verb-based labels under icons ("Manage billing"). Also test with screen reader users.
Maya (Design): Microcopy suggestion: "High-priority permissions shown; expand to edit full set." For invite defaults use "Default role for new invites" with a link to change.
Ivy (Frontend): Keyboard shortcut idea to open audit filtered for a role: press "g" then "a". We'll deep-link: /orgs/:id/audit?role=:roleId. Need RBAC checks.
Jon (PM): Good. Add tooltip text for the shortcut and list in keyboard shortcuts modal. Audit filter heading: "Showing changes for role: <role>"
Ivy (Frontend): Quick CSS for focus-visible:
```css
.role-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.priority-chip{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px}
```
Maya (Design): Action items:
- @Ivy: implement chip semantics + focus styles (ETA Tue)
- @Jon: finalize invite copy + add default role CTA (ETA Wed)
- @Carlos: recruit 6 admins + 2 screen reader participants (ETA Thu)
